name: EdrawMax
description: A cross-platform general-purpose diagramming suite that supports UML, flowcharts, organization charts, network diagrams, ER diagrams, collaboration, and AI-assisted features.
editorialNote: Imported from the UMLChina UML tools collection. The English summary is a concise editorial translation; capability fields remain Unknown unless the source explicitly states support.
sourceDescriptionZh: 老牌通用绘图软件，2019年被中国公司万兴科技（Wondershare）控股收购。支持流程图、组织结构图、网络图、UML、ER 图、平面图等多种图形，是Microsoft Visio的同类竞争产品。现已发展为覆盖Windows、macOS、Linux、移动端和浏览器的跨平台绘图工具，并加入在线协作和AI功能。
